method.period: Sentinel-2 dry seasons (June-October) 2021-2026; new = not roof in 2021-22, roof in every dry season from the built year on, for at least two seasons

detector.holdout: trained west of 440,000 E, tested east of it

radar.source: Sentinel-1 RTC VV, relative orbit 76 descending, dry-season median
radar.rule: 90th percentile VV over the patch and a 1-pixel ring must reach the level 90 % of known buildings of lead size reach in the last year; inside the patch it must not reach it in 2022

method.class_sources: OSM tag on or within 30 m of the patch (MEASURED); else an Overture place within 30 m (WEAK); else an OSM industrial or retail land-use area (WEAK); else unknown
method.note: Footprint is the new-roof patch on 10 m pixels (about +/- 1 pixel at the edges); a patch can hold more than one building. Filter 4 uses kecamatan piped coverage until PDAM releases coverage per kelurahan, and applies to hotels, malls and hospitals only: PDAM Tirta Moedal sold industry 0.22 Mm3 in 2022 (Perda Kota Semarang 4/2024, table 2-5).

funnel.label: New roof since 2022, at least 1,000 m2
... in a water-using class (factory, hotel, mall, hospital)
... inside a critical or damaged zone
... and for hotels, malls and hospitals, kecamatan piped coverage below 50% (proxy; not applied to factories)
Class unknown (no tag in OSM or Overture places), inside a critical or damaged zone: listed for a site check, not counted as leads
